property_summary: The reference contract always returns true when all sub-calls succeed; the buggy version reverts on any successful sub-call because it requires the sub-call to fail.
When all inner low-level calls succeed, transfer must return true; the mutant returns false, violating the expected return value.
For any successful non-reverting call to transfer, the return value must be true; the buggy version returns false, violating this invariant.

For any call to transfer with a non-empty _tos array and a caddress that, when called with abi.encodeWithSelector(id, from, _tos[i], v), does not revert for any i, the returned value must be true; the buggy version returns false, violating this invariant.

For any call to transfer with a non-empty _tos array and a caddress that does not revert when called at each _tos[i], the returned value must be true; the buggy version returns false, violating this invariant.
